test_clip_pytree: test the clipping.clip_pytree function to clip a PyTree of JAX arrays based on its global L2 norm
test_clip_pytree_nan_safe: test the clipping.clip_pytree function with nan_safe=True to handle NaN and infinite values in the input PyTree
test_clip_pytree_return_zero: test the clipping.clip_pytree function with return_zero=True to return a zero PyTree when clipping
test_clipped_fun_sensitivity: test the clipping.clipped_fun decorator to verify L2 sensitivity bounds for neighboring dataset relations
test_clipped_fun_aux_output: test the clipping.clipped_fun function with has_aux=True and keep_batch_dim=True to preserve auxiliary output shapes
